rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Die Bloemhoffer
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2001).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2001.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Ludwigs Roses says this rose celebrates the 125th Anniversary (in 2000) of the Hoer Meisie School Bloemhof in Stellenbosch... the color on the outside petals of the bud is cream tinted green. The inside of the opening bud displays a soft cream which is enhanced with a faint, but still distinct, pink hue on the edges of the petals...
